verdict.rationale: A virtual mailbox service could plausibly offer bulk data export, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that registered-agent documents are stored as PDFs in cloud storage, plus a general API for workflow control. That is a storage format and a developer building block, not a documented 'export all my data and leave' capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
